name: Horrors in the Highland
objectiveText: Kill a Highland Horror within Excavation Sites and bring its root core to Rethiel the Greenwarden in the Wetlands. Horrible Rootcore  ( 1 )

comments.body:
Prerequisites (Start: [url=https://www.wowhead.com/classic/npc=1239/first-mate-fitzsimmons]First Mate Fitzsimmons[/url]): 
1.	[url=https://www.wowhead.com/classic/quest=463/the-greenwarden]The Greenwarden[/url]
2.	[url=https://www.wowhead.com/classic/quest=276/tramping-paws]Tramping Paws[/url]
3.	[url=https://www.wowhead.com/classic/quest=277/fire-taboo]Fire Taboo[/url]
4.	[url=https://www.wowhead.com/classic/quest=275/blisters-on-the-land]Blisters on The Land[/url]
Correct, despite the Wowhead guide not pointing it out, you must do the previous 3 quests from the Greenwarden before he offers this one.
